bio.text: Tim Dukes was first elected in 2012 to represent Delaware House District 40, which includes Laurel, Delmar and Bethel.
According to his official page, House Republicans elected Dukes House Minority Leader in November 2024, and he previously served as House Minority Whip.
The page says Dukes is pastor of Central Worship Center, lives in Laurel, and lists the University of Valley Forge under education.
